items.title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator follow-up mode
items.description: Chat naturally with Facilitator without tagging it each time.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft M365): Delegated prompt publishing for organization prompts
items.description: This release follows the availability of organization prompts, providing admins the ability to upload custom prompts for their organization in the Copilot app home screen. Now, admins can delegate organization prompt publishing to users, AAD security groups, and distribution groups. These delegated users and groups will be able to create, edit and delete organization prompts at the tenant level through the Prompt Lab, without having to access the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. Admins can continue to monitor and provide oversight through the current experience in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center.

items.title: Outlook: Copilot Chat Sheet UX Update for Mobile
items.description: Copilot Chat in Outlook on iOS and Android is getting updated! You'll notice smoother animations, improved strings, and some small changes to the header, such as the new/temporary chat button being moved behind the ... button.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Quality Evaluation Agent - Review historical quality metrics in a unified dashboard
items.description: The quality evaluation historical dashboard provides aggregated insights from completed evaluations, helping organizations track quality trends over time. Users can view quality scores and trends across selected date ranges, with up to two years of historical data available.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Cowork: Access Business Applications with Work IQ
items.description: Users can access Business Applications through Work IQ in Copilot Cowork and use Business Skills to complete end-to-end business processes grounded in their enterprise data and apps. This helps users move from finding the right business application to taking action across key workflows with less context switching.

items.title: Work IQ: Business Skills to manage your business processes in Work IQ MCP
items.description: Business skills are natural-language instructions that capture how your organization gets work done. They represent your business processes, policies, and domain knowledge in a format that agents can understand and follow. Each skill describes how to complete a specific type of work—the steps involved, the information required, and the business rules that apply. Agents discover and use the business skills they have access to as needed at runtime using Work IQ MCP to complete tasks according to your organization's processes. When multiple agents use the same skill, they follow the same process, ensuring consistent behavior across your organization.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot People Connectors introduces people data ingestions with differentiated access control
items.description: Copilot People Connector now supports importing people data with access controls into Microsoft 365. This release enables organizations to bring people data from external systems into Microsoft 365 along with associated access control lists (ACLs), ensuring Copilot respects existing permissions defined in source systems. The imported data can be scoped to specific individuals and groups, allowing Copilot to reason over people data while honoring access restrictions.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Policy Sync & Device Health AI-Powered Investigation
items.description: AI agent skill to detect and alert unhealthy policy sync and device configuration.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Users will be able to upload files stored locally or in one drive to custom engine agents
items.description: Users will be able to upload files stored locally or in one drive to custom engine agents.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Rewrite by Copilot in Edge is being upgraded to include enterprise data protection compliance standards
items.description: Rewrite by Copilot in Edge, which lets users edit typed text for tone, format, and length within an open page in Microsoft Edge, is being updated to include enterprise data protection for commercial customers. Once Rewrite is available, users signed in with a Microsoft Entra ID will have enterprise data protection when using the feature in Microsoft Edge. Updated March 20, 2026: We have paused release of this feature temporarily and will announce new release timelines soon. We apologize for any inconvenience.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: DSPM-Copilot Readiness and Data Explorer
items.description: We’re introducing the new readiness for Microsoft Copilot and data explorer experiences in Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management (DSPM). These new capabilities provide data security teams with greater visibility into their organization’s data security posture and help them assess risks, investigate findings, and prioritize remediation. The readiness for Microsoft Copilot experience in Purview DSPM helps organizations assess and improve their data readiness for Microsoft Copilot. It brings together insights into sensitive data exposure, oversharing, and protection coverage, helping security teams identify risks and assess progress toward a more secure Microsoft Copilot deployment. The new data explorer experience in Purview DSPM provides a centralized investigation experience that helps organizations understand where sensitive data exists across sites, review site-level access, and explore relevant data through preset views. It brings together sites, sensitive data, and preset views, to support more efficient investigations and reduce context switching.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Federated Copilot Connectors in Microsoft 365 Copilot
items.description: Federated Copilot connectors enable users to securely connect Microsoft Copilot to their favorite third party sources, retrieving data in real-time using the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Federated Copilot connectors do not store or index customer data in Microsoft - access happens in real time using the user’s own identity, while administrators retain full governance and control through the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. With GA, federated Copilot connectors will be supported across Researcher agent and Microsoft 365 Chat, allowing users to bring data into their workflows.

items.title: SharePoint: HTML pages
items.description: Create HTML with Copilot in SharePoint or upload your own HTML from another source. Once stored in the pages library, you can render HTML as a page in SharePoint, make additional edits, and share with your audience. HTML gives you new ways to present your content beautifully alongside our existing ASPX pages.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Enable semantic model in Sales agent
items.description: Semantic model helps Sales Agent understand the structure and meaning of an organization’s CRM data. It creates a connected representation of CRM metadata, including tables or objects, fields, descriptions, data types, relationships, views, pick-list values, and glossary terms. Sales Agent can retrieve this context when responding to questions, improving its ability to interpret business language and answer complex questions that span related CRM records. Dynamics 365 admins can enable and turn on semantic model in Power Apps Maker Portal and configure the data coverage and signals that Sales Agent should use. Admins can configure the underlying data, views, metadata and relationships used in the model. For Salesforce customers, the semantic model will be based on existing Sales agent table and glossary configuration in Sales agent settings or Power Apps Maker Portal. In Power Apps Maker Portal, Salesforce admins will can configure additional Salesforce signals to use in semantic model such as relationships and views.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat in OneNote can create, edit, and refine content
items.description: Copilot in OneNote can generate new content and directly edit when in edit mode. In this mode you can create, rename, and delete pages, sections, or notebooks as well as add or edit content in pages. Copilot can bring content from across WorkIQ as well as complete actions across other workflows such as creating Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Commerce MCP Tools for POS Shift and Cash Management
items.description: This feature provides reusable Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools for Store Commerce shift and cash management, exposing Commerce capabilities as structured actions that customers, partners, and developers can compose into agentic experiences. The tools enable agentic experiences to list a store's registers and drawers; scan current shift status, including open, suspended, blind-closed, and invalid shifts; list shifts opened in a requested period, including those now closed; retrieve structured detail for one shift, covering lifecycle, operational, tender, cash, tax, and transaction totals; return X-report content for an open shift and Z-report content for a closed shift; open one shift on the signed-in worker's register; blind close, fully close, or declare counted tenders and then close an eligible shift; record a starting amount, float entry, tender removal, or tender declaration; and review, reconcile, or undo cash reconciliation records. Shift detail and X-report content are available while a shift is still open, so a host experience can apply its own thresholds to what is returned and alert a manager during trading rather than after close. All operations execute through existing Commerce shift, cash, and permission logic. Responses return structured data hosts can present as status, cash positions, blockers, and next steps. Setup is performed by an administrator or implementation partner. Customers configure the host surface, authorize the agent to call the tools from an authenticated Point of Sale session, and maintain existing drawer assignments, cash policy, and Point of Sale permissions in Commerce headquarters.

items.title: Work IQ: Execute (Recipes)
items.description: Enable agents to execute reusable Work IQ recipes that coordinate supported tools and actions.

items.title: Work IQ: Federated connectors
items.description: Enable Work IQ to use federated connectors for governed access to additional enterprise data sources.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): App Blocks
items.description: App Blocks enables M365 Copilot Chat users to turn their requests and data into rich, interactive experiences directly within the conversation, including calculators, dashboards, forms, planners, visualizations, simulations, comparison tools, and other interactive apps. It helps users move beyond static responses to explore data, adjust inputs, visualize outcomes, and simulate workflows in place, while supporting grounded scenarios where current information can be retrieved and then rendered into an interactive experience.

items.title: Planner: AI-generated Status Reports in Planner Agent
items.description: AI-powered Status Report in Planner Agent turns your plan data into a polished, stakeholder-ready update in minutes. Just ask Planner Agent for a status report and it pulls your task data and transforms it into a clear narrative covering overall status, progress, risks, and what's next. You can easily customize the report to your needs by specifying the audience, tone, length, and sections you want.

items.title: OneNote: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Windows)
items.description: Capture on Windows helps you bring conversations and ideas from meetings, brainstorming sessions, and everyday work into Copilot Notebooks. Capture audio, images, and notes in one experience, then let Copilot turn them into structured notes with key insights, decisions, and action items, in a Copilot Notebook of your choice

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Multiple Voice Styles in M365 Copilot voice chats
items.description: Users can select from multiple voice style options for their voice experience in M365 Copilot.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention to restrict processing external emails in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat
items.description: We are expanding Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat to safeguard risks from external emails. This real-time control helps organizations mitigate data risks by preventing Microsoft 365 Copilot and Chat from processing emails from senders external to your organization.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Realtime voice interactions in Word and PowerPoint
items.description: Use your voice to talk with Copilot, interact in-real time, and understand the content within your document or presentation. Updated September 9, 2026: We will be re-releasing this feature with updates in October. Thank you for your patience.

items.title: OneNote: Summary and Q&A in OneNote Mobile with Copilot (Iphone)
items.description: With this new Summary feature in OneNote mobile, you can create a short and fluent summary of your longer pages which will help to consume relevant information faster. With the Question and Answer at your fingertips, you can get real-time answers to your queries directly within your notes, enhancing your ability to access and utilize information quickly and effectively. We inadvertently marked this item as rolling out and now have updated it to be accurate. We apologize for any inconvenience.

items.title: OneNote: Summary and Q&A in OneNote Mobile with Copilot (Android)
items.description: With this new Summary feature in OneNote mobile, you can create a short and fluent summary of your longer pages which will help to consume relevant information faster. With the Question and Answer at your fingertips, you can get real-time answers to your queries directly within your notes, enhancing your ability to access and utilize information quickly and effectively.

items.title: OneDrive: Command-line tool for the OneDrive sync app
items.description: A new command-line tool, odcli, lets OneDrive users, IT admins and support engineers check and manage the OneDrive sync app from the command line. Commands cover sync status, accounts, configuration, policies, and managing the sync app. JSON output lets scripts, management tools and AI agents automate these tasks.

items.title: Work IQ: Memory capabilities expand to agents
items.description: A new Work IQ MCP path, /memory/me/coreMemories, gives authorized agents access to a user’s memory profile. This profile enables agents to provide more personalized and relevant assistance. At launch, it includes Custom Instructions, Saved Memories, relevant work account data, and memories derived from chat history. The memory profile will continue to evolve and improve over time.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Insights and Copilot Analytics in GCC and GCC High
items.description: We are expanding the availability of Viva Insights and Copilot Analytics capabilities in Microsoft 365 Government Community Cloud (GCC, or GCC-M) and GCC High (GCC-H). Availability differs for a small number of capabilities by cloud, as noted below. • Eligible users will see updated Insights app features and supported Insights Admin Center experiences. • Adoption and Impact experiences will include supported Copilot usage and impact measures, group and app views, trends, and filters. • Analysts will gain access to additional Advanced Analysis reports and queries. Supported users will also have sharing, delegation, and report-publishing capabilities. Cloud-specific differences • GCC only: Adoption by app for Edge and the Microsoft 365 Copilot app. • GCC High: Impact supports scope, organization, and time-period filters, but not license, job-function, or usage-level filters. Creating an analysis excludes Copilot.

items.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot (Microsoft 365): Accounting skills
items.description: Streamline corporate accounting work New accounting capabilities in Excel and Cowork help accountants spend less time on repetitive, manual tasks in the places they already work, including: • Reconcile accounts with confidence: Compare balances and transactions, identify discrepancies, and prepare reconciling items for review. • Prepare journal entries faster: Draft accruals, reclassifications, allocations, reversals, and recurring entries, with checks for required inputs and balanced entries. • Turn results into clear reporting: Analyze financial performance against plan, identify key drivers, and prepare reporting that explains what changed and why. Additional capabilities span audit, tax, FP&A, compliance, and training. Learn more about the full set of accounting capabilities here. Accountants are already putting these capabilities to work. In seven days of limited Insiders availability, more than 8,000 unique users invoked accounting skills over 44,000 times across more than 18,000 Copilot conversations. Across Excel and Cowork, finance professionals will also have the option to start an audit trail whenever they invoke an accounting capability. If selected, this will create a record in their chat history of what Copilot changed and why. This is available today in Excel and coming soon to Cowork.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - specify when receipts must contain a VAT number
items.description: Help ensure expense receipts include required company VAT information by applying your organization’s receipt validation rules. Expense Agent can check submitted receipts for a valid company VAT number (Tax ID) when your configured rules require one, and flag receipts for review or prevent them from moving forward based on your policies. Benefits • Configure when a company VAT number is required on submitted expense receipts. • Automatically validate required VAT information during expense processing. • Identify receipts that do not meet configured tax identification requirements and handle them according to your policies.

items.title: Outlook: Inline chat for email drafting
items.description: Instead of opening Copilot Chat every time you want to use Copilot to draft a message, this change introduces an inline chat component that streamlines the process and lets you interact with Copilot without opening the sidebar.

items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Usage reports – Microsoft 365 Copilot Connectors
items.description: A new usage report will be available in the Microsoft 365 admin center for Copilot Connectors in Microsoft 365 Copilot, designed to give organizations a detailed view of how connectors are being used within Microsoft 365 Copilot. This report provides insights into overall connector activity, and connector powered response patterns over time, along with detailed user-level connectors adoption data. With these analytics, admins can monitor adoption, identify usage patterns, and optimize Copilot experiences to drive greater value across their organization. #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Reimagine creation Phase In/Out rules to make it easier for users to enter in large volumes
items.description: Reimagine creation Phase In/Out rules. Allow users to pre-select Tables and Fields at Group level that will be populated on every rules. If a Table key field like Product ID is included in the rules, then auto fill related fields with values like Product Name, Product Group etc. Support for Phase In a new Product with out pointing to and old Product. Support Delete of a Dimension or Dimension combination so it no longer appear in timeseries Investigate if rules can be created via Copilot - Cowork

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Chat: Access to UBB models via the model selector
items.description: Users will be able to access models that require usage-based billing (UBB) from the model selector in Chat. Tenant admins will need to allocate credits so that users can interact with these models. If users consume their allotted credits, they will be able to request credits from their tenant admins.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Copilot in the Queues app on Mobile
items.description: Agents and supervisors can use Copilot in the Queues app on Mobile to quickly understand and follow up on customer conversations. From shared call history, users can ask questions about a past call and use Copilot to surface relevant information and insights from the conversation, helping them get up to speed and take the next step without having to review the entire call

items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Design POS screen layouts in a modern browser designer
items.description: Create and preview POS screen layouts in headquarters with a modern web designer that simplifies configuration and reduces design iterations. The Screen layout designer is modernized as a React-based web experience embedded in Commerce headquarters, with a JSON-based layout backbone replacing the legacy XML representation. The feature applies to Store Commerce point of sale (POS). The modernization includes these core capabilities: Visual layout and button-grid authoring: Arrange and resize supported POS components on a drag-and-drop canvas, configure properties, and edit associated button grids and POS operation mappings in a unified experience. Live preview: Inspect layouts and their associated button-grid operations while designing, and preview supported device sizes and orientations without distributing every design iteration to stores. Existing layout migration: Bring existing screen layouts and button-grid configurations into the modern designer rather than recreate them from scratch. Reusable configuration: Reuse layout templates with store-specific overrides to reduce the need to maintain duplicate layouts. Modern usability: Work with contextual properties, familiar Fluent UI controls, and inline validation. Administrators enable or disable the modern designer through feature management in headquarters. Authorized users open Retail and Commerce > Channel setup > POS setup > POS > Screen layouts , select a layout, and open the designer. They configure the layout and button grids, inspect the preview, and save changes to headquarters. Administrators distribute the saved configuration to stores through the existing Commerce data distribution process. Previewing changes does not replace the distribution needed to update Store Commerce. Setup is performed by a Commerce administrator, who enables the feature, grants appropriate headquarters permissions, and manages layout assignments and distribution. No separate ClickOnce designer installation or Copilot license is required for manual design.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: USA - Automate employee payments with ACH bank integration
items.description: Organizations in the United States can simplify employee expense reimbursements by paying approved claims directly to employees’ bank accounts through ACH. When used with the Expense Agent, approved reimbursements can be processed automatically, reducing manual payment handling and helping employees get reimbursed faster and more accurately.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Use tags to mark processed emails
items.description: Quickly see which expense-related emails have already been processed by Expense Agent, helping you distinguish processed from unprocessed messages with confidence. Expense Agent adds a **Processed by Expense Agent **tag in Outlook after a relevant email has been successfully processed. Benefits • Automatically marks successfully processed expense-related emails. • Provides a clear processing-status indicator in Outlook, reducing the need to verify status manually. • Makes it easier to distinguish processed from unprocessed expense-related emails.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Adding invited guests from calendar as participants to your expense
items.description: Spend less time manually adding attendees to meal-related business expenses. Expense Agent can match the expense to the relevant Outlook calendar event and add invited guests as expense participants, helping keep participant information aligned with the meeting invitation. Benefits • Automatically identifies relevant Outlook calendar meetings when expense participants are required. • Retrieves invited attendees from the matching calendar invitation. • Adds invited guests as expense participants without manual entry.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Change companies and environments in the web app
items.description: Manage expenses across multiple Business Central companies and environments more efficiently with the Expense Agent web app. Switch between the companies and environments you’re authorized to access within a single session, without restarting the app or signing in again. Benefits • Access multiple authorized Business Central environments from the Expense Agent web app. • Switch directly between companies while managing expenses. • Reduce context switching when working across multiple organizations, business units, or legal entities.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Set expense spend limits in Expense Management
items.description: Take control of employee spending earlier in the expense process with configurable spend limits. Define thresholds that reflect your organization’s expense policies and apply them by time period for individual employees, teams, or the whole company. Expenses that exceed predefined limits can be prevented or flagged, with immediate feedback during expense creation. Benefits • Proactively manage expenses before reimbursement and accounting processes begin. • Reduce approval rework by giving employees immediate feedback when expenses exceed defined thresholds. • Support budget adherence across employees, teams, and the organization with configurable spending limits.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Add tags for expenses as submitter
items.description: Make expenses easier to organize and categorize by adding relevant tags when you create or edit expenses in the web application. Add one or more custom tags to capture business, project, event, or other dimensional context beyond standard expense fields. Benefits • Add one or more custom tags while creating or editing an expense. • Capture relevant business, project, event, or other dimensional context with expense records. • Organize and categorize expenses beyond standard expense fields.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Enable approving limits and alternate approvers when primary is not available
items.description: Keep expense approvals moving when primary approvers are unavailable or when requests exceed their approval limits. Organizations can set a maximum approval amount—or unlimited approval authority—for each approver, designate a next approver for requests above that limit, and assign alternate approvers as temporary or scheduled backups. Approval requests can route to an alternate approver during periods of unavailability while following the same approval processes and controls. Benefits • Set approval limits for each approver and route requests that exceed those limits to a designated next approver. • Assign alternate approvers for ad hoc needs or planned periods of absence to help maintain approval continuity. • Reduce delays for employees submitting expenses by keeping approval requests moving when the primary approver is unavailable.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Create expense with no attachment
items.description: Save time when recording lower-value expenses by creating them in Expense Agent without an attachment when the amount is below the limit you set on the Expense Agent Setup page. This gives you the flexibility to record qualifying expenses even when a receipt or supporting document isn’t available. Benefits • Create qualifying expenses without requiring an attachment at the time of submission. • Set the amount limit that determines when an attachment isn’t required. • Record expenses below the configured limit even when a receipt or supporting document isn’t available.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Log the expense in a case of lost receipt
items.description: Expense Agent helps employees keep expense submissions moving when an original receipt is unavailable. It guides employees through providing the information needed to support the expense, generates supporting documentation from those details, and enables them to continue the reimbursement process without manually creating replacement documentation. Benefits • Provides a guided process for documenting expenses when receipts are lost or unavailable. • Reduces manual effort by automatically generating supporting documentation from employee-provided information. • Creates a more consistent lost-receipt process for employees and finance teams.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Split your expenses
items.description: Split a single expense across multiple allocations so costs are accurately assigned to the appropriate expense user, project, department, customer, or expense category. Expense Agent helps you define the split and ensures the allocations add up to the original expense amount. Each allocation is recorded separately for reporting and accounting while remaining linked to the original expense. Benefits • Accurately distribute expenses across multiple users, projects, departments, customers, or expense categories. • Define expense splits with help from Expense Agent while keeping allocations aligned with the original expense total. • Maintain separate allocation records for reporting and accounting while preserving the connection to the original expense.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced Copilot and AI controls for meetings
items.description: Teams Meetings offer enhanced AI controls for Copilot and AI experiences. Organizers manage who can enable and access AI, while IT admins get a simpler policy model for governing AI across meetings and post-meeting experiences. These updates provide more predictable administration and greater flexibility for compliance and governance scenarios.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Ask Copilot from Search on Mobile
items.description: Get answers without leaving search. As you type in the Teams search bar, you'll see an option to ask Copilot alongside search results. You can also select Ask Copilot from the search results page to turn your query into a Copilot conversation, helping you quickly find information, get answers, and ask follow-up questions in context.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Autonomously generate quotes and drive sales with Sales Development Agent
items.description: Sales Development Agent (SDA) can take leads from qualified opportunities to closed deals. Key capabilities include: Generating quotes through D365S as well as 1P/3P systems and sharing them with customers to company branded templates. Connectivity to quoting and transaction systems managed through Agent 365 MCP registry. Answer questions about the quote and adjust details based on customer feedback. Facilitate customers completing self-service transactions. Escalating to human sellers when customers are blocked and need human intervention. Configuration through interactive chat experience with each agent instance.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): New Microsoft 365 Copilot usage reports for Copilot Search, Connectors, and Agents for US Government customers
items.description: We are introducing new Microsoft 365 Copilot usage reports for Copilot Search, Copilot Connectors, and Copilot Agents for US Government customers across GCC Moderate, GCC High, and DoD environments. These reports will provide administrators with organization-level and user-level insights to help them understand usage and adoption of these Copilot capabilities.

items.title: Planner: Capabilities in Microsoft Cowork
items.description: You’ll soon be able to bring your Microsoft Planner into Microsoft Cowork. In Cowork, you can view, create, and update your plans, buckets, goals, and tasks without switching apps. Cowork goes a step further by helping you execute your Planner tasks across Microsoft 365, such as drafting and sending emails, scheduling meetings, posting updates to Teams, and working with files. It can then write progress back to Planner with your approval. You can move from planning your work to getting it done in one place.

items.title: Planner: Save AI-generated filters in Planner Agent chat
items.description: Save AI-filters generated by the Planner Agent for future use on your plans.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: AI-generated meeting memory for knowledge retention (formerly AI-generated meeting archive)
items.description: Teams will store AI-generated meeting memory files for meetings where Intelligent Recap was turned on, allowing Copilot (and Facilitator) to retain key insights from meetings beyond transcript retention periods and when a transcript was not saved. This enables Copilot to continue answering questions about past meetings even after the transcript expires or the meeting is over. Admins can also configure how long this AI-generated meeting memory file is stored.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Planner capabilities in Copilot chat (M365 Copilot)
items.description: We will support creating Planner tasks and plans querying Planner information in M365 Copilot chat, allowing users to manage their tasks and plans between Copilot and Planner seamlessly.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Copilot studio cost controls in MAC
items.description: We’re expanding cost management for Microsoft Copilot Studio into the Microsoft 365 admin center. This gives administrators a more centralized way to manage Copilot Credit spend across usage-based AI workloads while retaining Copilot Studio cost management capabilities in the Power Platform admin center. With this update, administrators can bring supported Copilot Studio environments and agents under Cost Management spending policies. Resource-based policies for environments and agents are the first planned scopes, with broader user and group policy support planned for a later phase. Furthermore, this update will introduce cost data into cost management and agent registry for AI services and agents built on Microsoft platforms (e.g., Cowork, Microsoft Copilot Studio agents).
products: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration

items.title: Microsoft Contact Center Intelligence: Biometric authentication
items.description: Voice biometric authentication delivers business value by reducing fraud and agent operating costs in contact centers. Voice-based verification improves identity assurance shortens call durations reduces customer service rep effort and enable secure self-service transactions. At the same time, it improves customer experience and scalability by authenticating callers naturally as they speak. This enables consistent, risk-based security across high call volumes without adding authentication friction or process complexity.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Create expenses from credit card feeds
items.description: Expense Agent now supports creating expenses from imported credit card transaction feeds or automatically reconcile with them if the expense was created earlier. Key capabilities include: Import credit card transaction data and review it in the web and mobile apps. Automatically create expenses from imported card transactions. Match imported transactions to existing expenses, where applicable. Reduce duplicate data entry by leveraging transaction details already captured from credit card feeds. Credit card transactions are manually imported into the Credit Cards Feeds from the file. The system processes the imported transactions and identifies transactions eligible for expense creation. Expense Agent creates draft expenses using transaction information such as merchant, date, and amount. You can review the suggested expenses, and complete any required information before you submit. Matching capabilities help associate imported transactions with existing expenses, which helps avoid duplicates and improves reconciliation.

items.title: Outlook: All Accounts view (Unified Inbox) brings your email into a single inbox view
items.description: The All-Accounts view, also known as Unified Inbox, lets you see emails from multiple accounts in a single inbox view in the new Outlook for Windows, without merging your mailboxes. Each account's inbox stays separate; the view brings them together so you can triage in one place. Users can read, delete, move, archive, and mark messages across accounts without switching between mailboxes. The experience integrates with Copilot for AI-assisted email workflows and supports Immersive Search for finding messages across your primary account. Advanced scenarios such as cross-account search and shared mailbox support will follow in later releases.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat in Outlook expands to reason over inbox, calendar, and enterprise data
items.description: Copilot Chat in Outlook expanding to support reasoning over a user's entire inbox, calendar and other enterprise data for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat users (without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license) .

items.title: Microsoft Contact Center Intelligence: Universal connector for self-service omnichannel agents
items.description: Bring Microsoft AI to the contact center platform of your choice with the Universal Connector. Organizations can now integrate Microsoft self-service voice and chat agents with virtually any contact center using a simple API-based approach. The Universal Connector enables seamless handoff from AI agents to human representatives while preserving the full conversation context, ensuring a connected and personalized customer experience across every interaction. This flexibility allows organizations to modernize at their own pace by bringing AI-powered experiences to their existing contact center investments without requiring a costly migration or platform replacement. Whether supporting voice or chat experiences, customers can quickly extend intelligent self-service capabilities while maintaining continuity across AI and human-assisted engagements.

items.title: Microsoft Contact Center Intelligence: Tools
items.description: Tools are building blocks that let your agent interact with external systems. Tools expand what your agent can do, and your agent can perform various actions in response to user requests or autonomous triggers. Each tool represents a specific capability that your agent can perform. For example, you can equip your agent with tools that perform tasks like: Send emails by using the Office 365 Outlook connector Check the current weather conditions and forecasts Read and write data from Dataverse Read and post messages to Teams

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Historical analytics
items.description: Contact Center historical analytics provides out-of-box historical reporting for Dynamics 365 Contact Center, built on a shared analytics foundation. It moves reporting from heavier workload-specific Power BI models toward a shared analytics foundation with conformed facts, shared dimensions, pre-built aggregations, and common definitions across conversations, sessions, agents, queues, channels, CSAT, handle time, and operational KPIs. Customers can continue using out-of-box Power BI reports while gaining extensibility through Fabric, Direct Lake, SQL, Spark, and custom lakehouse models.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Shared analytics for historical reporting
items.description: Dynamics 365 Customer Service provides out-of-the-box historical reporting built on a shared analytics foundation: a scalable, open, and AI-ready data foundation for Customer Experience and AI analytics scenarios across Dynamics 365. It uses a lakehouse-based architecture that can scale with data volume, supports curated analytics datasets for direct querying, and enables consistent reporting and semantic definitions across reports, agents, and copilots.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management-Legacy Teams retention policies covering Copilot will be treated as Teams-only
items.description: Some existing retention policies scoped to Microsoft Teams may currently also apply to Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions. As part of an upcoming change, these legacy Teams retention policies will be converted to—and treated as—Teams-only policies. They will no longer implicitly govern Copilot workloads.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Envision and design AI agents in Business Central
items.description: AI agents in Business Central Business Central introduces AI agents to help users automate repetitive tasks and make business processes more intelligent and efficient. These agents act as specialized assistants that understand context, handle structured data, and collaborate with users to complete end-to-end workflows. For example, the Sales Order Agent simplifies order creation by transforming natural language or email instructions into complete sales documents, while the Payables Agent streamlines vendor invoice processing by extracting key details from incoming invoices and matching them to purchase orders—all reducing manual effort and freeing users to focus on higher-value work. The agent runtime that powers these built-in agents provides core capabilities that enable the use of agentic AI within Business Central. AI agents are defined, configured, activated, and run directly inside the familiar Business Central environment—leveraging the same security model, administration tools, and user experience as the rest of the product. Results are displayed in-context, with intuitive navigation to related data and entities, allowing users to control the agents through the interface they already know. This consistency dramatically reduces the learning curve, builds trust, and ensures efficiency when working with AI agents. The agent runtime ensures that every step taken by an agent is traceable and operates strictly within the access boundaries (permissions) assigned during configuration. It provides a timeline view of all agent activities, allowing users to review what happened and why—enabling a true human-in-the-loop experience. The runtime can also memorize relevant data during execution, use it in subsequent steps, and request additional instructions in natural language when user input is needed. It helps ensure that sensitive operations always require explicit user review and consent, supporting full transparency and control. Business Central business processes are inherently multistep, stateful, and financially consequential. The agent layer must be able to interact with a broad set of ERP capabilities and data, sequence operations with a high degree of accuracy across dependent steps, handle the data respecting permissions, company, environment, and tenant boundaries, provide a contextual audit trail, and keep humans in the loop. Business Central agentic strategy intentionally separates deep, well controlled, in-context and transparent execution within the product from cross-system orchestration. Business Central agents form the foundational layer inside the product, exposing well-defined agent capabilities that in the future will be possible to surface as MCP tools and consume by Declarative Agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft 365. This layered approach enables Business Central-tuned, transparent, managed execution at the ERP core processes, while allowing higher-level Declarative Agents to orchestrate end-to-end business processes across products. Designing agents The new in-product experience for designing agents that automate Business Central processes is made available with AI Development Toolkit for Business Central. The experience offers a low-risk environment for envisioning and prototyping new AI agents tailored to your own business scenarios—extending the same agent runtime capabilities used by built-in Business Central agents. Built for rapid iteration, the designing experience lets you create and refine custom agents using natural language instructions, define their behavior, test agent profiles and permissions, and safely experiment with Business Central data in a sandbox environment. This approach empowers partner personas like consultants, product owners, and domain experts, as well as developers and even power users, to explore new scenarios, validate ideas, and build confidence in their agents before moving to production. Whether you aim to automate repetitive business processes, streamline data processing, or deliver proactive insights, the agent design experience gives you the tools to bring your vision to life. Agent instructions At the core of every agent are its goals and instructions, defined in natural language. Writing agent instructions is similar to writing prompts for large language models, so you can apply general prompt-writing best practices—and even use tools like Copilot to optimize them. The agent design experience includes a simple editor to help you define, refine, and test these instructions efficiently. Invoking your agent You can invoke your agent by manually creating a task for it. When doing so, you can include an additional message that provides specific details or context to complement the agent’s core instructions. Although the ability to design your own agents is in public preview, there aren't yet any built-in integrations to automatically trigger these custom agents based on incoming emails, events, or scheduled recurrences (this can be done by professional developers using the APIs available in the AI Development Toolkit). However, you can simulate these scenarios by including the email header and body in the task message to mimic incoming emails, or by manually triggering the agent to emulate event, UI action, or time-based runs. Troubleshooting When running the agent tasks in the designing experience, you can access detailed diagnostic views to help you understand and tune the agent execution. Since an agent’s decisions depend on its instructions, available data, and language model reasoning, you can review execution logs to see its inputs, reasoning process, and outputs. This helps you identify where uncertainty occurred and why specific decisions were made to adjust your agent instructions. Importing and exporting agents To make it easy to back up or move custom agents across sandbox environments, the in-product experience allows you to import and export agent definitions. These definitions are stored as simple JSON files containing properties such as agent identity, instructions, assigned profiles, and permissions. We recommend storing these files in a source control system like GitHub to track changes and maintain version history. Responsible AI Agents built using the agent design experience adhere to Microsoft’s Responsible AI principles, helping you ensure agent compliance, fairness, and safety. Billing As with the built-in Sales Order and Payables agents, custom agents consume Copilot credits as they perform their steps. Credits can be provisioned through prepaid or pay-as-you-go models, providing flexible cost management as your AI usage scales. Business Value: Agents in Business Central are AI-powered team assistants that go beyond traditional automation. Unlike static workflows or hard-coded AL logic, agents can interpret high-level business goals expressed in natural language and translate them into actionable steps. They reason over Business Central data, make informed decisions within defined boundaries, and collaborate with users through human-in-the-loop approvals for critical operations. The benefits are substantial: agents reduce manual effort by automating repetitive or complex tasks, allowing users to focus on higher-value activities. They adapt to dynamic business scenarios that can't always be anticipated during development, offering flexibility that traditional automation lacks. Most importantly, agents operate transparently: every action is logged, permissions are rigorously enforced, and users remain in control at all times. This combination of intelligence, adaptability, and accountability makes agents a cornerstone of the next generation of ERP experiences. With the agent design experience, we're taking the first steps toward enabling you to build your own custom Business Central agents. Enabled for: Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Use AI resources for your Copilot extensions
items.description: Using the AI resources provides several benefits: Reduced operational overhead : Avoid the need to handle infrastructure management, updates, monitoring, troubleshooting, or maintenance of custom Azure OpenAI subscriptions. This benefit frees up resources to focus on core business operations and provides value-adding intellectual property (IP) to customers. Simplified onboarding : Quickly integrate AI capabilities into your solutions without having to navigate the complexities of setting up and managing your own Azure OpenAI subscription. Improved reliability : Proactive scaling, throttling, load balancing, and fault tolerance measures ensure consistent performance during peak demand. Enhanced security compliance : Built-in compliance measures and governance, including robust protection from malicious and harmful content, ensure compliance with data residency requirements. This benefit reduces the burden of ensuring regulatory compliance for ISVs. Streamlined experience for customers : Customers get a seamless AI resource management process without maintaining different configurations for separate ISV solutions. This capability also provides a cohesive AI consumption tracking and billing experience for Business Central customers. Customers who use AI resources across multiple AI-enabled solutions built with Business Central customer developer tools for Copilot benefit from a unified approach to AI consumption monitoring and invoicing. They don't need to reconcile multiple invoices or metrics from separate ISVs. For details on billing costs, see AI tools at Message scenarios . For most publishers, the default Business Central AI resources are enough. However, if you need specific models, including fine-tuned models, that the Business Central AI resources don't provide, you can bring your own subscription for customers. In this case, the publisher is responsible for deploying, maintaining, scaling, and securing the service. The publisher also handles billing AI resources to customers. We recommend using the developer toolkit AI resources when you extend Copilot in Business Central. You just need to authenticate with the SetManagedResourceAuthorization method in the AI Module AzureOpenAI codeunit. You also provide your own Azure OpenAI subscription details, but the authentication process doesn't use them. (Update 2026 release wave 1: There's now a new method signature for SetManagedResources that doesn't require you to provide your subscription details anymore. You should use that going forward.) // Example of using the default toolkit AI resources in AL AzureOpenAI.SetManagedResourceAuthorization(Enum::"AOAI Model Type"::"Chat Completions",AzureOpenAIAccountName,AzureOpenAIApiKey,AOAIDeployments.GetGPT4oLatest()); To use your own subscription, authenticate it with the SetAuthorization method. // Example of using your own Azure OpenAI subscription in AL AzureOpenAI.SetAuthorization(Enum::"AOAI Model Type"::"Chat Completions",GetEndpoint(),GetDeployment(),GetApiKey()); This AI billing model isn't designed to replace the existing Marketplace monetization pathway for publishers who create Business Central apps. Instead, it offers another option that simplifies AI consumption for customers and partners. ISVs can use the Marketplace monetization option to monetize their IP. Business Value: A key feature of the developer tools for Copilot in Business Central is that publishers in their Marketplace apps use large language models through Microsoft-managed Azure OpenAI resources when they extend Copilot in Business Central. This approach eliminates the need for customers to independently get and manage Azure OpenAI subscriptions. Using the Business Central AI resources is the default and recommended approach. However, some partners or customers might have special requirements that require them to use their own Azure OpenAI subscription when running the feature in production or when developing and testing in sandboxes, which is also supported in the developer tools for Copilot in Business Central. Enabled for: Enabled for admins/makers/marketers automatically

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Data: Agents and Copilot - Increase AI accuracy by grounding agents in customer insights
items.description: The Customer Insights MCP server allows AI agents and chat experiences to access and understand insights generated by Customer Insights - Data. The Customer Insights MCP server uses the industry-standard MCP architecture to securely share unified profiles and insights with AI agents and chat experiences, providing the data context so AI agents can do their best work. AI tools can use the Customer Insights MCP server to: Resolve Dataverse contacts and leads to their unified customer profile. Access extended customer information unified by Customer Insights - Data from external sources not available to Dataverse. Understand calculated measures for a customer such as their purchase totals over the last 4 months, or the date of their most recent engagement. Quickly discover what segments the customer is a member of. See if a customer has multiple redundant contacts in your system, and which is considered authoritative for that customer. Get predictive insights for the customer such as Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) and Churn risk, giving you greater insights into the customer's current relationships with your company. Scenario Sally is a seller who is evaluating a lead named Joe who recently attended a product launch webinar. Sally asks her AI embedded on their Contact and Lead forms if there are any insights about this lead and is delighted to find that the lead Joe is matched to a VIP customer Joseph who has existing paid licenses for several products. Because Customer Insights - Data unifies her company's external Purchase and Rewards data with Dataverse contact and lead data, the agent informs Sally that Joe is a valued Rewards and Loyalty points member, and it is able to provide other AI-generated insights such as the Customer Lifetime Value score, Churn Risk, and the segments Joe is a member of. Armed with a wealth of customer data, Sally is able to engage Joe and upsell Joe on their new product. Business Value: Agents give your marketing, sales, and service teams essential insights and can automate many business processes. But agents are only as good as the data they work with. When you give them access to customer insights that unify your customer data sources, you can get more valuable and actionable insights that enable organizational efficiencies that you couldn't achieve before. Now, more insights generated by Customer Insights - Data can be leveraged from within Microsoft Copilot Studio, allowing you to turn insights into a powerful business asset. Copilot Studio, and even your own custom copilots created in Microsoft Copilot Studio, can now simply and easily get access to more insights, allowing agents to understand, share, analyze, and act on these insights. Every team member gets tailored information and tools to reach their goals efficiently. Enabled for: Enabled for admins/makers/marketers automatically

By clustering data dynamically, you can make better decisions, optimize inventory, and reduce costs from overstocking or stockouts. Queries across tables to answer your business question. No skill names. No tool flags. No context switching between docs, CLI, and scripts. The agent handles the orchestration end-to-end. Business Value: By using coding agents, you can eliminate the need to manually create Microsoft Dataverse tables and solutions through the UI. Dataverse skills guide coding agents to connect to your environment and build solutions by using tables, relationships, forms, and views. This process also includes creating sample data. All suggested changes require explicit user approval before being applied. After execution, the agent confirms what was updated, ensuring full transparency and control. By combining guided setup, continuous review, and contextual recommendations, the security agent helps keep Power Pages sites secure from initial configuration through ongoing maintenance. Business Value: Security agent empowers makers to set up secure access controls without needing deep security expertise. It uses AI to recommend the right roles and permissions for your data tables. It continuously monitors your site for misconfigurations, helping you reduce risk, ensure compliance, and build customer trust. Enabled for: Enabled for admins/makers/marketers automatically

items.title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Optimize resource scheduling - Optimize schedules with Scheduling Operations Agent
items.description: Dispatchers often spend considerable time and energy reviewing and adjusting each technician's schedule as conditions change throughout the workday: A technician has one or more cancellations in the afternoon. To fill the open slots, what requirements optimally keep promise windows, prefer high-priority work, and locate work around the same neighborhoods that the technician is due to travel to? A technician is running over the planned time for the current booking. As a result, they're late for the next booking, and the delay might cascade to subsequent bookings. How do you best adjust the bookings for the remainder of the day? A technician recovers from illness sooner than expected and is now available for work earlier than planned. What's the best way to schedule work for them when they return? A technician’s schedule contains a lot of low-priority work that isn't due for weeks. How can you improve the schedule with work that better meets desired business goals? A technician’s schedule for the day is built manually or with the schedule assistant. How can you rearrange the schedule so that the resource’s travel time is reduced? In each case, the dispatcher needs to assess the situation, determine which business goals apply, and then update the schedule manually, one booking at a time. With this release of the Scheduling Operations Agent, dispatchers can ask Copilot to provide the best schedule for the affected technician. Within seconds, the dispatcher gets a suggested schedule for review and can apply the updates. You can direct Copilot to optimize for the business goal you want, such as maximizing technician usage or work order priority. Copilot intelligently chooses among existing bookings and new unfulfilled work orders based on factors like skillset match, territories, and customer promise windows. Users can access the feature from the Copilot side pane anywhere within the Dynamics 365 Field Service application. Business Value: The Scheduling Operations Agent for Dynamics 365 Field Service enables dispatchers to quickly and easily optimize schedules for technicians as conditions change throughout the workday, so they can significantly improve their productivity. Dispatchers can ask Copilot to optimize schedules and address issues such as traffic delays, double bookings, or last-minute cancellations that often result in conflicts, gaps, or idle time in a technician's schedule. Instruct Copilot to achieve the desired business objective, such as maximizing technician usage or work order priority while considering factors like skillset match, territories, and promised time windows. Enabled for: Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users
