items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys: Improve engagement and message timing with Outreach Optimization Agent
items.description: Add the Outreach Optimization Agent to your journey, select the emails you want delivered, and let the agent handle timing and cadence automatically. With Outreach Optimization Agent, you can: Start with an intelligent baseline : Outreach Optimization Agent automatically creates a baseline messaging plan for your audience by analyzing overall historical engagement patterns, producing a smart, generic plan that is designed to work well for most customers before any individual optimization kicks in. Listen to incoming interactions and adapt the plan in real time : The agent continuously monitors incoming signals, including engagement and non-responsiveness, and adjusts follow-up timing and cadence, or exits the plan based on whether the goal is progressing or has been achieved. Respect quiet times : The agent enforces quiet time settings as a hard constraint, ensuring that messages are never sent outside approved communication windows, even if engagement data suggests otherwise. Scenario A global retail brand uses Outreach Optimization Agent in a seasonal campaign to re-engage customers. Unlike previous efforts with fixed schedules and repeated reminders, the agent creates a smart baseline plan, then adjusts message timing for each customer based on their engagement. It slows or stops follow-ups when customers show interest and spaces out reminders for unresponsive customers, all while respecting quiet times and consent. This leads to better engagement and less message fatigue, with minimal manual intervention.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Author Commerce receipt formats with Copilot Cowork
items.description: Use natural language in Copilot Cowork to create, update, translate, and check Commerce receipt layouts using existing formats in headquarters. The Commerce receipt format designer skill lets authorized users work with receipt layouts through natural-language requests in Copilot Cowork, using receipt configuration in Dynamics 365 Commerce headquarters. It applies to receipt formats used by Store Commerce point of sale (POS). Users can: Create and adapt formats: Start from an existing format in the modern Receipt designer representation, create a new format, or request changes to an existing target. Edit receipt sections: Modify header, line, and footer content, field positions, alignment, and supported formatting. Translate and personalize content: Translate static labels and add user-supplied text while preserving dynamic fields. Missing business details are identified rather than invented. Check layouts without changing them: Request structural or geometry checks that identify overlaps, width violations, and truncation risks, with findings and suggested remediation. Verify saved changes: Review the resulting format and changes, with saved configuration re-read to confirm the requested update. Creating a format from a source preserves that source. The skill is available automatically to authorized Copilot Cowork users. Users describe the source format and desired outcome, resolve any source or target ambiguity, and review the results. A Commerce administrator ensures appropriate headquarters access and that the source format is available in the modern structured representation. Structural checks do not establish visual appearance, barcode scanability, runtime values, or legal and fiscal compliance. Users review the layout in the Receipt designer and perform appropriate test printing before operational use. Assigning formats to receipt profiles or printers and printing or reprinting transactions are separate setup and operational workflows.

items.title: Microsoft 365: [Education] Provide a Copilot starter prompt in Teams and LMS Assignments
items.description: Educators can provide a Copilot starter prompt from Student AI Guidelines in Teams and LMS Assignments. Students open Copilot with the educator's prompt ready in their chat, helping them begin with instructions tailored to the assignment.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Sales Development Agent - Meeting scheduling
items.description: Sales Development Agent can turn a prospect’s interest in meeting into a booked seller meeting. The agent asks the prospect to provide preferred dates and times, evaluates those options against the appropriate seller’s calendar, and books the first valid option in the prospect’s stated preference order. The seller and prospect receive the meeting invitation, while the seller receives additional conversation context to support a warm handoff. If scheduling cannot be completed, the agent transfers the request and relevant context to the seller for follow-up.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Sales Development Agent is now available
items.description: Autonomous agent that researches, qualifies, engages with leads, scaling sales capacity 24/7.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Use Expense Manager role center
items.description: The Expense Manager Role Center is updated to provide a more focused and efficient experience for managing vendor and expense-related activities. The enhancements align the workspace with typical expense management workflows, ensuring that key information and actions are readily accessible. Where relevant, other Role Centers are also updated to include access to expense management features.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Add an interim approver when you submit an expense report
items.description: This feature introduces support for a simple interim approval scenario for expense reports. When someone submits an expense report, organizations can designate an interim approver to review and approve expenses before the final approver can review and approve. Interim approver must review expense reports to confirm whether they're complete and compliant before final approver.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Create expense reports per trip automatically
items.description: Expense Agent can automatically create expense reports based on identified business trips. You just need to configure the feature on the Expense Agent Setup page. Instead of manually collecting and organizing individual expense entries, you can use the agent to group relevant expenses and generate a dedicated expense report for each trip. Key capabilities include: Administrators can specify whether the company wants to group expenses by trip and not only by period. Automated expense report creation without requiring you to manually start and organize reports after a travel requisition is approved. Automatic trip-based expense grouping associates eligible expenses with the correct business trip based on information in the travel requisition. The agent automatically groups not only expenses based on the location, but uses intelligence to group all expenses based on the context. Non-trip related expenses keep existing period-based grouping in expense reports.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: AI-powered notes for in-person meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Windows
items.description: In addition to capturing real-time notes and meeting outcomes during scheduled or hybrid meetings, the Facilitator agent assists you with notes, decisions and actions for in-person meetings in Teams Rooms on Windows. Simply invite Facilitator with one tap of the room console. Meeting notes appear on the front of room display or touch board, are available via meeting recap when shared, and deleted if no one selected. Rest assured no data remains in the room. Available with Teams Rooms Pro.

items.title: Microsoft Dataverse: Enable semantic data understanding for agentic use
items.description: Give AI agents and Copilot a true understanding of your business data — not just raw schema — so they can answer questions accurately with less manual configuration. Learns from the systems you already run — Automatically extracts semantic knowledge from views, forms, and metadata already defined in your Dataverse environment, reducing agent deployment from days of manual setup to near-zero effort. Full visibility for makers — View generated semantic knowledge per entity — including name, description, and sample questions — directly in the Power Apps maker portal. Search for understanding gaps and enrich missing context with a built-in glossary for domain-specific terms. Governance and privacy built in — Enable or disable semantic signals at the org level, or at the individual signal-type or table level, giving makers and admins granular control to meet compliance and privacy requirements without sacrificing agent quality. No manual schema mapping. No custom query logic. No disambiguation between what your data is called and what your business actually means.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Manage intraday operations with AI agent
items.description: Intraday Agent is an autonomous AI agent that helps manage intraday operational scenarios. The following are its high-level capabilities. Intraday queue tracking Continuously monitors queue volumes in real time. Detects anomalies when actual volume deviates significantly from forecasted demand. Automatically reforecasts in real time to assess current demand. Notifies supervisors with proactive alerts and recommendations. Automates corrective actions such as adjusting schedules, rescheduling breaks, or reallocating service representatives to maintain SLA performance. Supports customizable instructions to align mitigation actions with business needs. Intraday adherence tracking Monitors service representative adherence to scheduled shift activities in real time. Detects deviations such as late logins, extended breaks, or early logouts. Autonomously mitigates deviations through actions such as break rescheduling, shift extensions, overtime activation, or flexible channel reassignment. Supports customizable instructions to align mitigation actions with business needs.

items.title: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration: Multi-grader comparison
items.description: Multi-grader comparison enables makers to compare the results of multiple graders applied to the same evaluation. The experience highlights agreement, differences, and overall grading behavior. Core capabilities The core capabilities include: Compare graders side-by-side. Compare scores. Review explanations from each grader. Analyze grading consistency. Results experience Results include: Comparative score view. Pass / fail comparison. Grader explanations. Evidence supporting each evaluation.
products: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration

items.title: Word: Legal plugins in Copilot
items.description: Legal plugins in Copilot provide purpose-built skills to help legal professionals summarize, draft, review, and redline legal documents. Available in Word and Cowork, these plugins can use work context from Microsoft 365 and connect to supported third-party legal sources.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Export metrics from Agent Dashboard
items.description: Users can export de-identified, row-level agent metrics and attributes from the Agent Dashboard. Exported data provides detailed insights into agent usage and user-level agent interactions across the organization, with personal identifiers removed. #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Enhanced Microsoft Copilot in Viva Engage
items.description: Introducing the Enhanced Microsoft 365 Copilot Experience in Viva Engage! Powered by Engage MCP, this enhanced experience takes Copilot in Engage beyond catch-ups and summaries, helping users explore conversations more deeply, synthesize discussions, and uncover meaningful insights. It's also more deeply connected across Microsoft 365. For example, you can ask Copilot to analyze feedback on a leader's post, identify key themes, and turn those insights into a reusable PowerPoint deck. With Work IQ integration, Copilot also has a better understanding of you and your work context, connecting conversations in Engage to your broader work across Microsoft 365. Engage MCP expands both the breadth and depth of Engage scenarios Copilot can support, making it more useful for understanding conversations and insights across your Engage network. This update also brings Copilot in Engage closer to the broader Microsoft 365 Copilot experience, with your Microsoft 365 agents now accessible directly within Copilot in Engage.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Support for sensitive documents protected with Microsoft Purview Information Protection (MPIP)
items.description: Unblock users from upload files with Microsoft Purview Information Protection (MPIP) sensitivity labels to Copilot Studio agents deployed on the M365 channel. With this support agents can process content based on the user's/agents account permissions, with label protections enforced end-to-end.

items.title: Work IQ: Human in the loop
items.description: Allow agents and agent flows to pause for human input or approval before continuing.

items.title: Work IQ: Agent Policy Governance
items.description: Provide administrators with policy-based controls for governing agents and their capabilities at scale.

items.title: Work IQ: Real Time Transcripts
items.description: Enable applications and agents to access Microsoft Teams meeting transcripts in real time for assistance and insights.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Meeting Shared Files
items.description: The new Meeting Shared Files feature allows users to add relevant files and links to their meeting for easy access and to automatically share that content with all meeting participants. AI in the meeting, like the Facilitator agent, uses these files for targeted grounding to answer questions and enhance skill functionality.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Edit your document with Copilot in PowerPoint in Government Clouds
items.description: Copilot in PowerPoint helps you create, edit, and refine presentations through natural language—right inside your deck. Start a new presentation or build on an existing one by asking Copilot to generate slides, update content, improve layouts, and polish design, all while preserving your formatting, structure, and branding. Copilot can also connect to your brand kit to apply branded templates, insert brand-approved images, and check for brand compliance. Available to Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) users.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Archive SharePoint files under retention policies
items.description: With the introduction of file archiving support in SharePoint Online, administrators are looking to seamlessly include archiving actions within their existing data retention policies. This means that, in addition to keeping or deleting data, admins want to now leverage Purview DLM to archive files according to organizational requirements, ensuring comprehensive governance across all stages of the content lifecycle in SPO. Retention based file archiving moves inactive content to low-cost storage, lowering costs with no compromise on Compliance, keeping data discoverable and making Copilot results highly relevant.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Agent metrics for custom reporting in Insights analyst workbench
items.description: Unlock deeper insights into Copilot agent adoption with flexible, self-serve analytics. Insights global and partition analysts can access and combine granular agent usage metrics with agent and organizational attributes to uncover agent adoption trends, export and customize reporting, and drive more informed decisions, without relying on predefined dashboards.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot in PowerPoint for Government clouds
items.description: Copilot in PowerPoint lets you create, edit, and refine presentations through natural conversation, directly in your presentation. You can start a new presentation or build on an existing one, asking Copilot to generate slides, update content, improve layouts, and polish design—while preserving formatting, structure, and branding. Copilot uses your files, meetings, emails, and more to help shape content and iterate quickly, and it connects to your brand kit so you can apply branded templates, insert brand approved images, and check for brand compliance. Available to Microsoft 365 Copilot–licensed users.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Compliance Manager-Purview Compliance Manager integration with Microsoft Foundry for automated mapping of AI regulations and evaluation of Compliance controls for Foundry Agents
items.description: This feature in Purview Compliance Manager shall enable customers to automatically access the compliance posture of Agents created in AI Foundry. Customers can map Agents being created in AI Foundry to compliance regulations and assessments in Purview Compliance Manager and get to know the compliance status and improvement actions to be innovative and compliant.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Purview SDK embedded in Agent Framework SDK
items.description: Purview SDK embedded in Agent Framework SDK enables developers to seamlessly integrate enterprise-grade security, compliance, and governance into the AI agents they build. This integration enables automatic classification and protection of sensitive data, prevents data leaks and oversharing, and provides visibility and control for regulatory compliance—empowering organizations to confidently and securely adopt AI agents in complex environments.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Agent 365 reporting availability for Microsoft platform agents
items.description: Customers can now view agent insights in the Agent 365 Dashboard in Microsoft Viva Insights (Copilot Analytics) without an Agent 365 license. Customers will be able to view reporting on their Microsoft platform-built agents in one consolidated picture, along with context on who built each agent and why.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Auto-open Copilot side pane for Outlook links
items.description: When users open links from Outlook, Microsoft Edge can automatically open the Copilot side pane to provide contextual insights and actionable suggestion chips based on email and destination content - such as highlighting key points, and recommending next actions - without disrupting the browsing flow. This experience helps users quickly understand content, take action with fewer steps, and get more value from Copilot while extending productive browsing time in Edge. Admins can control availability to this feature using the M365LinksAutoOpenCopilotEnabled policy.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Optimize resource scheduling - Optimize multiple resources with Scheduling Operations Agent
items.description: This release expands the optimization capabilities of the Scheduling Operations Agent to include multiple resources. The agent considers the availability of the resources, their current schedules, and unscheduled requirements. It suggests a schedule that honors configured constraints and optimizes it according to the selected goal. Dispatchers can review and compare the proposed schedules with the current schedules before applying changes. New capabilities include: Optimize schedules for up to 5 resources directly from the schedule board. Optimize schedules for up to 30 resources using an optimization plan. Create custom goals and weight objectives. Create custom optimization scopes to use with your optimization plans. These capabilities build on the existing public preview of the Scheduling Operations Agent and will be automatically enabled for all organizations that have the agent enabled. Learn more at Scheduling Operations Agent documentation . Business Value: Optimize multiple resources with the Scheduling Operations Agent (SOA). Schedule up to five resources directly from the schedule board or Copilot or perform ad-hoc optimizations for up to 30 resources using an optimization plan. This feature streamlines scheduling, improves efficiency, and supports better resource management. Enabled for: Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Finance: Business performance - MCP for ERP Analytics
items.description: MCP for Analytics provides AI agents with structured access to ERP analytics data and tools. It ensures agents use the same definitions and models as users. Key benefits: Data Access : Gives agents access to ERP analytics data for analysis and insights. Metrics and Dimensions : Provides access to key metrics, dimensions, and relationships used in reporting. Semantic Model : Exposes the full semantic model to support consistent interpretation of data. Tool Access : Enables agents to connect with tools like Power BI and Business Performance Analytics. MCP makes ERP analytics data agent-ready, reliable, and explainable. Business Value: MCP for Analytics allows agents to access ERP analytics data and tools with context. It ensures consistency across metrics, dimensions, and hierarchies so agents can reason reliably. This improves trust in insights, reduces duplication, and simplifies development of explainable agent experiences. Enabled for: Enabled for admins/makers/marketers automatically

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Detect intraday volume spikes with workforce alerts
items.description: Supervisors can create volume spike alerts that compare real-time conversation volume with the forecast linked to a shift plan. When volume remains above forecast for the configured number of intervals, selected recipients receive an in-app notification. The capability includes the following features: Administrators can enable workforce alerts in Copilot Service admin center by going to Workforce management > Intraday management > Workforce alerts . Supervisors can create and manage alerts from Workforce alerts in the Copilot Service workspace site map. Each alert references a shift plan and monitors the queues associated with its linked capacity plan. Supervisors can specify the percentage by which actual volume must exceed forecast volume. Supervisors can specify the number of consecutive intervals during which the deviation must continue before an alert is raised. The forecast determines whether an interval is 15, 30, or 60 minutes. Supervisors can set an expiration date to limit an alert to a campaign, season, or known event. Supervisors can select one or more notification recipients for each alert. Active alerts are evaluated on a recurring schedule. Notifications are sent when the configured threshold and duration are met. Recipients can select a notification to open the alert details. The details include the queue and alert name, detection time, current and forecast volumes, spike percentage, and an interval-by-interval breakdown. Access and prerequisites An administrator must install the Workforce Management for Customer Service package from Power Platform admin center. Forecasting and scheduling must be configured. The selected shift plan must have a linked capacity plan and forecast. Real-time conversation data must be available for the monitored queues. Business Value: Contact centers plan staffing based on forecasted demand, but actual demand can change quickly. When conversation volume rises significantly above forecast, queues can grow and service levels can decline before supervisors have time to respond. Workforce alerts help supervisors identify unusual intraday volume changes without continuously monitoring a dashboard. Supervisors define the deviation and duration that represent a volume spike and select who should be notified when those conditions are met. The notification provides information about the spike, including how far actual volume is above forecast and whether the deviation is continuing. Supervisors can use this information to decide whether to shift capacity, offer overtime, or defer offline work while these actions can still help protect the customer experience. Enabled for: Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Omnichannel customer experiences - Use ML-based sensitive data redaction for human interactions
items.description: Dynamics 365 Contact Center introduces large language model (LLM)-based sensitive data redaction for human-to-human interactions, allowing administrators to automatically redact PCI data shared during live conversations between customers and customer service representatives. The system uses LLMs to identify sensitive data based on conversational context, not just patterns, across both voice and digital channels. When sensitive data such as a credit card number, PIN, or account number is detected, it is replaced with a standardized redaction token (for example, CreditCardNumber:Redacted) before the data is persisted. Redaction is applied consistently across: Conversation transcripts Call recordings Logs and diagnostic data Analytics outputs derived from conversations Administrators can configure which PCI data types are redacted, and the system enforces these policies automatically without requiring representatives to pause recordings or change their workflows. This capability helps ensure that sensitive customer data isn't stored while preserving the non-sensitive conversation context needed for quality assurance, analytics, and operational insights. Business Value: Organizations in regulated industries must prevent sensitive payment data from being stored in call recordings, transcripts, logs, or analytics artifacts. Today, customers rely on manual processes or limited rule-based masking, which increases compliance risk and operational overhead. This feature enables customers to safely use recording, transcription, and AI analytics by ensuring payment card information (PCI) data shared during live conversations between customers and customer service representatives is automatically redacted before storage. As a result, customers can reduce PCI scope, prevent compliance escalations, and confidently adopt advanced contact center capabilities without disrupting agent workflows or customer experience. Enabled for: Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations cross-app: Boost productivity with Copilot - Boost agent performance with optimal tool execution paths in Dynamics 365 ERP MCP
items.description: With the dynamic tools of the Dynamics 365 ERP MCP server, large language models often have multiple options for tool-calling sequences to perform an operation or retrieve data. The orchestration can select the tool execution sequence and can include more tool calls than are required. This enhancement to the MCP server improves performance and accuracy of the server response by enabling the server to use optimal tool execution sequences to perform operations with a single point of entry for MCP tools and a semantic index of the available menu items, entities, and actions. Business Value: The Dynamics 365 ERP MCP server now uses a semantic index of target ERP menu items, entities, and actions to improve performance and accuracy of tool calls by optimizing the sequence of tool executions for agentic operations. Enabled for: Enabled for admins/makers/marketers automatically

items.title: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Copilot and AI innovation - Understand forecast accuracy with AI explanations
items.description: By combining forecast results with contextual insights, planners can gain a detailed understanding of the key factors influencing each forecast rather than simply viewing the numbers. This increased transparency builds confidence and supports more informed planning decisions. Key benefits include: See symmetric mean absolute percentage error (SMAPE) values. View historical data and forecast results in one place. Understand forecast drivers through AI-generated explanations. Gain greater confidence in planning outcomes. Make faster and more informed business decisions. These capabilities help planners spend less time analyzing forecast changes and more time acting. Business Value: Get a clear view of historical data alongside a calculated forecast supported by AI-generated explanations. This feature enhances planners' understanding of each forecast, builds confidence in the results, and enables better planning decisions. Enabled for: Enabled for end users automatically

items.title: Microsoft Dataverse: Microsoft 365 collaboration - Discover, build, customize, and extend with management MCP server
items.description: The management MCP server is a build surface and registry for agent-ready tools available within a customer's environment. It exposes an addressable endpoint where developers and agents can discover, assemble, and deploy MCP servers made from trusted components including connector actions, tools from other MCP servers, and custom APIs. Discover available tools and servers Find MCP servers authored, hosted, or certified by Microsoft Query and explore over 1,470 connectors and their individual actions Discover custom APIs available in your organization or from partner teams Create and customize MCP servers Build new MCP servers by selecting connector actions, APIs, and reusable tools Clone an existing MCP server, such as a Dataverse MCP, and tailor it by adding or removing tools to match your scenario Use MCP servers as modular, scenario-focused endpoints that can be reused across agents Endpoint driven developer experience Accessible as a simple environment scoped URL—no UI required Use in Visual Studio Code, Claude, or any agent or tool that supports HTTP Compose, publish, and maintain MCP servers entirely through API calls Enterprise ready governance and control Enforce data loss prevention (DLP) policies Apply access controls at both the MCP server and individual tool level The management MCP server gives you everything you need to build and scale agents using tools you already trust, no interface required, just secure, extensible control from the systems you already manage. Business Value: The management Model Context Protocol (MCP) server gives developers and system integrators a central API-based foundation to discover and build custom MCP servers. Through a single environment scoped endpoint, teams can find Microsoft certified or internal MCP servers, search across 1,470 connector actions and APIs, and create new or customized MCP servers with the exact tools their agents need. This capability reduces redundant development and enables a flexible, secure path from prototype to production across platforms like Visual Studio Code and Claude. Enabled for: Enabled for admins/makers/marketers automatically

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Monitor intraday performance against the forecast
items.description: The intraday performance report provides supervisors with an interval-level view of performance against the forecast. In Copilot Service workspace, go to Workforce management to access the report. Compare forecast and actual contact volume and average handle time. Variances appear as values and percentages, making outliers easier to identify. Compare forecast, required, and scheduled staffing levels to identify understaffed and overstaffed intervals. Review service level, occupancy, and schedule adherence alongside volume and staffing data in a single report. View data in 15-, 30-, or 60-minute intervals to match how your organization manages intraday performance. Filter the report by planning group and shift plan to focus on the areas you manage. Access and prerequisites To use Workforce Management capabilities, an administrator must install the Workforce Management for Customer Service package from the Power Platform admin center. Business Value: Contact center forecasts and schedules are built days or weeks in advance, but demand rarely arrives exactly as planned. When volume spikes, handle times run long, or agents are absent, supervisors often don't see the gap until service levels have already slipped and the interval is gone. The intraday performance report closes that gap by showing plan versus actual as the day unfolds. Supervisors can see which intervals are under- or over-staffed and act while there's still time by moving agents between queues, adjusting break and training schedules, or opening overtime only where it's genuinely needed. That protects service level and abandonment targets on the days that matter most, and it curbs the two costs that quietly compound in every contact center: paying for idle capacity in over-forecasted intervals and paying premium rates to recover from under-forecasted ones. Enabled for: Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Finance: Core financials - Enable import of customer payment remittance advice for processing and settlement
items.description: This feature includes the following functionalities: Automated customer payment and remittance advice import, scanning, and mapping using AI processing in the integrated Power Platform environment. Matching remittance advice data with data in Dynamics 365 Finance. Seamless integration of remittance advice details into Dynamics 365 Finance customer payment journals and the settlement process. Reports that provide insights into payment and settlement statuses, outstanding invoices, and overall cash flow. Business Value: The ability to import remittance advice streamlines the accounts receivable process by enabling businesses to efficiently manage and reconcile payments from customers. By automating the import, scanning, and consumption of remittance advice data, businesses save valuable time and resources. This capability improves cash flow management and financial reporting. Enabled for: Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Seller experiences - Clone and share Sales Development agent configuration across teams
items.description: As a sales leader, you can configure a Sales Development agent once, then share or clone its configuration across your organization. Distribute the agent’s playbook, guidelines, guardrails, and settings to other business units to provide a consistent experience across sales teams. The feature supports these capabilities: Export a configuration : In Teams, ask the source agent to package its configuration into a file. For example, enter Export your configuration. Import a configuration : Attach the exported file to a new agent, then ask the agent to apply the configuration. Create a one-time copy : The copied configuration is a snapshot, not a synchronized connection. Changes made later to the source agent aren’t automatically applied to the target agent. Knowledge sources, such as uploaded documents, FAQs, and URLs, aren’t included in the exported configuration. Add them directly to the target agent after importing the configuration. Business Value: Scaling your sales operations just got easier. Instead of manually configuring each Sales Development agent from scratch, you can now set up an agent once with your organization's best practices and guardrails, then share or clone it across your entire team. This means faster deployment, consistent outreach to prospects, and more time for your sellers to build relationships instead of repetitive work. Whether you're expanding to new markets or rolling out agents across multiple business units, you'll maintain quality and compliance while reducing the time it takes to get your agent up and running. Enabled for: Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Copilot and AI innovation - Use agentic simulations to evaluate contact center setup
items.description: Agentic simulations are an AI-driven capability of Service Operations Agent that enable organizations to evaluate how their contact center behaves under realistic customer conditions before those conditions occur in production. Administrators define simulation scenarios using natural-language prompts. Agentic simulations then generate realistic synthetic conversations, runs them end-to-end through the configured contact center, and calculates the contact center KPIs. What problems it helps solve Readiness of self-service experiences : Assess how AI agents handle real customer intents, variations in behavior, and edge cases. Effectiveness of assisted service flows : Validate routing, assignment logic, and service representative experience in human-assisted scenarios. Confidence in scale and load readiness : Understand how configurations and operations perform under realistic volume and fix any reliability and latency issues. Preparedness of service representatives : Enable safe practice and evaluation using realistic customer interactions without impacting live customers. Key capabilities Natural-language prompt interface for defining simulation scenarios Simulation of varied customer intents, personas, and behaviors End-to-end execution across AI agents, routing, and configurations Out-of-the-box KPI dashboards and scorecards Reusable and saved prompts, including canned scenarios Safe, pre-production execution with no impact on live customers Agentic simulations are currently available for the voice channel in the English language only. They support flows without Dual-Tone Multi-Frequency (DTMF)-based menu interactions and up to five conversations in a simulation. Business Value: Every contact center decision, such as deploying an AI agent, adjusting routing, onboarding new staff, or preparing for higher volumes, ultimately answers the same question: “Will this work as expected when real customers arrive?” Agentic simulations provide a clear, data-backed answer before changes reach production. By generating realistic customer conversations and running them end-to-end through the contact center, organizations can see how their self-service, assisted service, and operational setup behave under real-world conditions. Instead of relying on assumptions, limited testing, or post-go-live corrections, teams gain measurable insight into experience quality, readiness, and scale. This feature transforms how contact centers operate: Experience quality improves because AI agents and service representatives are evaluated against realistic scenarios. Operational risk decreases because configuration and routing issues are identified early. Time to value accelerates because onboarding, training, and change validation happen faster. Scale becomes predictable because load behavior is understood before demand increases. Agentic simulations turn uncertainty into confidence, helping organizations ship changes faster, train teams better, and deliver consistent customer experiences at scale. Enabled for: Enabled for admins/makers/marketers automatically

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Administrator experiences - Use industry templates to set up autonomous contact centers
items.description: This release introduces industry-specific templates that simplify the creation and deployment of autonomous contact centers. Organizations can start with a preconfigured template in Copilot Service admin center > Service Operations Agent and deploy an autonomous customer service experience in just a few clicks, significantly reducing the setup effort required to design agents, workflows, and service journeys from the ground up. The templates are built around common industry scenarios and best practices, helping organizations quickly establish operational autonomous contact centers while maintaining flexibility for customization as business needs evolve. Users can leverage these templates as a foundation and extend them to meet their specific customer service requirements. These templates enable organizations to rapidly launch autonomous contact centers, reduce implementation complexity, and begin delivering AI-powered customer support with minimal configuration effort. In this release, templates are available for the retail and telecom industries. Business Value: Accelerate the deployment of autonomous contact centers with prebuilt industry templates designed to help organizations get up and running in minutes rather than weeks. These ready-to-use templates reduce the complexity of designing autonomous customer service experiences from scratch, enabling businesses to quickly realize the benefits of AI-powered customer engagement, automated issue resolution, and around-the-clock service availability. Enabled for: Enabled for admins/makers/marketers automatically

items.title: SharePoint: Copilot Search in SharePoint and OneDrive
items.description: Copilot Search brings AI-powered, natural-language search to SharePoint and OneDrive, combining relevant results, AI-generated summaries with source references, intuitive filters, and a seamless handoff to Copilot.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Microsoft Copilot in Field Service Mobile app
items.description: Microsoft Copilot in the Dynamics 365 Field Service mobile app brings conversational AI chat capabilities directly to frontline workers. Once enabled, technicians can ask natural-language questions about Dynamics 365 Field Service data and receive contextual answers based on the app experience and their organization’s Dataverse data. With standard capabilities, Dataverse Q&A supports questions such as “What is the work history of this asset?” or “Who worked on this job last?” Organizations can also extend the with custom experiences and agents available to frontline and back-office users.

items.title: Excel: Excel canvas
items.description: A Copilot-generated canvas that turns workbook data into a polished, interactive view of key visualizations, metrics, and insights. As workbook data changes, it automatically updates to reflect the latest information. Users can modify the canvas by chatting with Copilot.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator detects and answers questions
items.description: Facilitator now automatically detects open questions raised during a Teams meeting and offers to help answer them using web search. When a participant asks a question (e.g., “What is an LLM?”) and no one answers, Facilitator posts a prompt offering to find an answer. Participants can select “Yes” to have the agent retrieve and share the information.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Export Copilot metrics in the Copilot Dashboard
items.description: This enables users to export row-level Copilot metrics from the Copilot Dashboard for reporting and deeper analysis.

items.title: Planner: Planner Agent in Copilot V2 Improvements
items.description: Planner Agent brings Planner’s intelligent work management directly into Copilot Chat, enabling users to create, update, and manage personal tasks and shared basic plans without switching context. Integrated across Microsoft 365, it provides insights into priorities, deadlines, and at-risk work, along with interactive task cards to help users stay organized and keep work moving. Building on the initial launch, planned improvements include: Improved context handling and support for larger plans. Higher-quality responses through model upgrades, refined prompts, and better grounding. Greater reliability and reduced latency for more consistent, responsive interactions. Expanded task management capabilities, including broader task assignment support. User experience enhancements to make managing tasks and plans in Copilot Chat more intuitive. New capabilities, including scheduled task catch-ups.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Express face enrollment
items.description: Express face enrollment makes it easier for users to create a face profile in Teams by using their camera during eligible meetings, after they opt in. Once enrolled, users can be recognized in supported Teams Rooms experiences, helping identify who is in the room and improving downstream meeting experiences such as Copilot and recap. Admins can enable or disable the feature for their organization.

items.title: SharePoint: Agent chat web part
items.description: This is a new web part available for modern page editors in SharePoint. The web part can be configured to use any M365 Copilot agent.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention-Admin Units Support for Copilot & Cowork DLP
items.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention is extending Administrative Units support to Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Cowork. This enables organizations to delegate management of supported Copilot DLP policies to administrators within their assigned Administrative Units, supporting regional, departmental, and regulatory boundaries without granting tenant-wide policy-management permissions. Existing tenant-wide policies continue to apply, and configuration is optional for organizations choosing to use Administrative Unit (AU)-scoped management.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Enable MCP tools for POS returns
items.description: This feature provides reusable MCP tools for Store Commerce POS returns. These tools expose Commerce return capabilities as structured actions that customers, partners, and agent developers can use to build conversational or agentic return experiences. The tools enable agentic experiences to look up the original purchase using supported identifiers such as receipt, order, invoice, or confirmation number; retrieve matching transactions and returnable lines; identify items that are returnable, partially returnable, already returned, or not returnable; create a return using selected lines, quantities, and reason codes; determine eligible refund options for original-tender refund scenarios; and execute eligible original-tender refunds through existing Commerce return and payment logic. The tools can also explain return eligibility, policy restrictions, and why specific lines may or may not be returnable. They can analyze prior returns and refunds to surface duplicate-refund risk, frequent-return patterns, cross-store return history, or other return-risk indicators. Tool responses provide structured data that host experiences can use to present return details, choices, summaries, and next steps in the experience they build. Customers can use these tools from POS-embedded agents, chat-based copilots, workflow orchestrators, or other agentic surfaces. Setup is performed by an administrator, IT owner, or implementation partner. Customers configure the host surface, authorize the agent or integration to call the tools, and maintain existing Commerce return policies, reason codes, tender rules, and payment configuration.

items.title: Power Apps: Manage model-driven app AI features from consolidated settings
items.description: Consolidated AI settings make it easier for makers and admins to find and manage AI capabilities for model-driven apps across two complementary surfaces. In Maker Studio, the Settings dialog in the model app form designer adds a new top-level Copilot and AI tab. Makers can see and adjust all available AI options for the app in one place instead of finding them scattered among all the other settings. In the Power Platform admin center, model-driven app AI settings are consolidated from Environment > Settings into Copilot Hub > Power Apps . This provides a central location for settings such as Generative pages, Copilot in apps, and the in-app AI skills. The in-app skill settings are organized into these groups: Data entry: Form fill assistance. Summary: Row summaries. Data analysis: AI-generated charts and natural-language search and filtering. Labels and descriptions are aligned across Maker Studio and Copilot Hub so makers and admins can understand how the controls relate. As part of this consolidation, the old model-driven app AI switches under Environment > Settings will also be retired and removed. Availability Field Value Applies to Model-driven apps Release Channel Weekly Version 2610.3 Feature Scope Admins or makers

items.title: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Procurement Agent - Define custom scenarios for agent-generated supplier emails
items.description: Business end-users and buyers can define and maintain their own outbound follow-up scenarios and use them wherever built-in scenarios are used today: Scenario maintenance — a dedicated setup page where users create, edit, and maintain custom follow-up scenarios. Each scenario carries its own name, the instructions that shape the email the agent writes, and the business entity it applies to. Scenario-driven configuration — follow-up configurations are built around the chosen scenario, so criteria, email content, and agent behavior all follow the scenario the user selected. Scenario-driven runtime — when the agent runs, it generates and sends messages according to the selected scenario's intent and instructions. Self-describing configuration history — scenario details are captured with each saved configuration, so the audit history of an agent configuration remains readable even if the underlying scenario definition is later changed or removed.

items.title: Outlook: Copilot Chat available in shared and delegate mailboxes
items.description: Shared mailbox users and delegates with read and manage (full access) and/or mail folder-level permission will now be able to access Copilot Chat directly from their shared and delegate mailboxes in classic Outlook, when added as a resource .

items.title: Work IQ: Microsoft IQ
items.description: Provide a unified intelligence layer that helps agents discover, reason over, and use organizational knowledge.

items.title: Work IQ: REST endpoint tools
items.description: Enable agents to use supported REST endpoints as tools through governed Work IQ integrations.

items.title: Work IQ: A2A and MCP elicitation
items.description: Enable A2A and MCP tasks to request missing information or authorization and then resume.

items.title: Work IQ: A2A and MCP long running tasks
items.description: Enable durable long-running A2A and MCP tasks with progress tracking, later result retrieval, and cancellation.

items.title: Work IQ: Retrieve
items.description: Enable agents to retrieve relevant Microsoft 365 content and context through Work IQ.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Lifecycle Management - Retention based on Last Accessed for files in OneDrive and SharePoint
items.description: This creates the ability to apply Retention to each SharePoint or OneDrive item based on when it was last accessed by a user. #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Integrate the Sales Development agent with Salesforce
items.description: Sales Development Agent now integrates with Salesforce, enabling organizations to use SDA with their existing Salesforce CRM. SDA can access leads, manage prospect records, log sales activities, and keep engagement actions—including qualification, disqualification, and ownership changes—connected to the CRM workflow. The integration uses Microsoft’s Salesforce Model Context Protocol (MCP) server to connect SDA with Salesforce.

items.title: Power Apps: Model-driven applications in Business Apps in Work IQ
items.description: Power Apps model-driven apps are now available as Business Apps in Work IQ. They can be accessed through the Work IQ (Preview) tool in Copilot Studio or through a natural-language chat experience powered by Work IQ MCP. In either experience, natural-language prompts let users list and read records or create, update, and delete them. For create and update, Work IQ maps supplied values to the appropriate app fields. Before a change is submitted, the proposed values require explicit user confirmation.

items.title: Work IQ: Updating documents in Office
items.description: Work IQ enables agents to create and edit Microsoft Office documents using organizational context, helping users produce and update content more efficiently.

items.title: Work IQ: Upload
items.description: Enable agents to upload files and content to supported Microsoft 365 destinations.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft M365): Copilot Chat can now better match search results from text that appears inside images embedded in Word and PowerPoint files
items.description: Copilot Chat can now better match search results from text that appears inside images embedded in Word and PowerPoint files is user's working files — such as scanned contracts in Word, text from tables, text from images — content that was previously difficult to search and find.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Dashboard - Targeted Audience Surveys
items.description: Targeted Audience Surveys let change leaders launch a Copilot Pulse survey directly from the Copilot Dashboard to all licensed or active users. Audiences update automatically using Insights data and respect existing dashboard filters like organization and job function, with privacy protected through population-level reporting only. Pair adoption metrics with employee sentiment in just a few clicks.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot in Forms - US Government clouds
items.description: Copilot in Forms is being enabled for Microsoft Forms in Government Cloud environments, bringing end-to-end AI assistance to forms, from creating a form, to refining and sending to analyzing results. This rollout includes key Copilot features such as: - Draft with Copilot - Distribution and monitoring - Copilot Insights - On-canvas Copilot features such as Rewrite question, Continue writing, Answer explanations, and more.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Archive SharePoint files under retention
items.description: We are introducing file archiving support in SharePoint Online, utilizing this feature administrators can seamlessly include archiving actions within their existing data retention policies. This means that, in addition to keeping or deleting data, admins can now leverage Purview DLM to archive files according to organizational requirements, ensuring comprehensive governance across all stages of the content lifecycle in SharePoint Online. Retention based file archiving moves inactive content to low-cost storage, lowering costs with no compromise on Compliance, keeping data discoverable and making Copilot results highly relevant.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Choose the data sources AI-powered Data Enrichment uses, including CRM notes
items.description: AI-powered Data Enrichment now lets admins choose which data sources the agent uses to enrich records. Outlook emails, Teams meetings, and the new CRM notes source each have their own control toggle, and the agent keeps running as long as at least one source is toggled on. Admins no longer need to connect every permission before they create the agent. With CRM notes, the agent extracts insights from manual notes added to supported records and uses them to enrich those records, with no tenant admin consent needed to use CRM notes. Only notes added by users with a Dynamics 365 Sales Premium license are used, and Dataverse search is needed only for emails and Teams meetings, since notes are already linked to their records. These control toggles are available automatically. Admins can turn each source on or off in the Agent behavior section of the Data Enrichment settings. Outlook emails and Teams meetings stay off until their permissions are connected, and connecting a permission never turns a source on by itself. For organizations already using the agent, CRM notes is off by default and a banner lets admins know it's available. For new organizations, CRM notes is on by default.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Procurement Agent - Customize the Procurement Agent supplier follow-up criteria
items.description: Organizations often use business-specific data and criteria to determine when suppliers require follow-up on purchase orders. The Procurement Agent will enable buyers to extend supplier follow-up criteria using related standard, extended, and custom table data. Buyers can add table joins and use fields from those tables as filter conditions, providing greater flexibility to determine which purchase order lines qualify for supplier follow-up based on their organization’s processes and data.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Scheduling with Copilot
items.description: Users can now schedule appointments and meetings directly from chat. Simply ask Copilot to create an appointment or schedule a meeting with colleagues, and it will find available times, book rooms, draft agendas, and send invites—all within the chat experience.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Discover and use shared plugins in Copilot Studio
items.description: Copilot Studio now connects to Microsoft's shared plugin registry, making it easier for makers to discover and use plugins, connectors, and other available capabilities. This integration provides a more consistent way to extend agents with capabilities across Microsoft's AI ecosystem.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Conversational configuration of connectors in Copilot Studio
items.description: Configure the connectors your agent needs, with a simple in-chat sign-in instead of a full settings experience.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Viva Engage - Community Agent
items.description: Community Agent helps members get answers to questions in Viva Engage communities using community knowledge and connected sources. Community admins can choose to require human review before answers are posted or allow automatic posting.

items.title: SharePoint: AI input widget and content preview in Copilot
items.description: With this new capability, users of Copilot in SharePoint will be able to view saved and unsaved preview content side by side with chat. Users will also be able to interact with created HTML forms and confirm responses to send to chat.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Expanded agent coverage in Agent Dashboard
items.description: Customers can now view reporting for agents from third-party platforms in the Agent 365 Dashboard in Microsoft Viva Insights (Copilot Analytics). This expanded coverage provides a more comprehensive view of agent activity across their organization.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Audio Overview updates in Copilot Notebooks
items.description: We're rolling out new capabilities for Copilot Notebook audio overview that make it easier to navigate longer content with topic-based episodes, new audio formats such as Critique and Debate, support enterprise information protection with sensitivity labels, and expand audio overview context to more content types.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: DSPM – New Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management Experience
items.description: At Ignite, Microsoft is introducing a major evolution of Purview Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) to help organizations strengthen data security and confidently embrace AI. The new DSPM experience unifies visibility and control across traditional data and AI-driven environments, delivering outcome-based guided workflows that turn insights into actionable steps—so teams can prioritize risks and remediate faster. It brings AI observability, enhanced posture reporting, and intelligent Security Copilot agents to automate tasks like triage and policy management. Plus, Purview now extends coverage beyond Microsoft data with third-party signals from partners like BigID, Cyera, OneTrust, and Varonis, giving security teams a single, streamlined view of sensitive data across clouds and platforms. Together, these innovations make DSPM the central hub for managing data security posture in the era of AI. We are also extending Data Risk Assessments to Fabric and to item-level analysis with new remediation actions like bulk disabling of overshared SharePoint links.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Workforce Insights Agent
items.description: Workforce Insights (WFI) Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot is an agent designed to help leaders, managers, and their delegates quickly understand their organization by turning complex workforce data into clear, actionable insights. With WFI Agent, leaders can quickly explore their organization’s structure, team composition, skills inventories, and flexible work patterns to move from insight to action in a single, unified experience directly in Copilot or Teams.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Adding contextual nudges to the Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat icon
items.description: Edge for Business will soon help users quickly take contextual action on their open pages using contextual nudges attached to the Copilot icon in the toolbar

items.title: Outlook: User-initiated Copilot insights in classic Outlook
items.description: Users can manually select text and ask Copilot to help provide relevant information.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent call delegation
items.description: Incoming Teams calls don't wait for a break in your day. Intelligent call delegation provides AI-powered calling assistance so you can focus on the conversations that matter most. It answers calls and gathers context, helping you decide whether to pick up and engage the caller. It can also schedule follow-up appointments through an integration with Microsoft Bookings so you can reconnect with callers at a more convenient time.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Agent Dashboard.
items.description: Viva Insights is creating an Agent Dashboard, designed to be a central place for leaders, delegates and analysts to understand how your organization is adopting agents. #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Cloud Attachments preservation for users on hold
items.description: Enables cloud attachment preservation for users put on infinite hold so that file versions shared are preserved across any OneDrive or SharePoint site. This is a new capability which is different from the existing capability of applying label to cloud attachments and links present in OneDrive and SharePoint and shared in Exchange, Teams, Viva Engage and Copilot

items.title: Outlook: Draft, edit and format emails conversationally with Copilot in Outlook
items.description: In Outlook, Copilot now works side by side with users to draft, refine, and format emails conversationally, powered by the same agentic capabilities available in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Automate optimizations with Scheduling Operations Agent
items.description: This release expands the optimization capabilities of the Scheduling Operations Agent to include the ability to create recurring optimizations on a schedule. The agent considers the availability of the resources, their current schedules, and unscheduled requirements. It suggests a schedule that honors configured constraints and optimizes it according to the selected goal. The agent automatically runs optimizations and applies the results on the configured schedule. New capabilities include: Configure optimization plans to run on a recurrence schedule. Add and weight additional objectives to optimization goals. These capabilities build on the existing public preview of the Scheduling Operations Agent and are automatically enabled for all organizations that have the agent enabled. Learn more at Scheduling Operations Agent overview .

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Use Dataverse Business Skills in Sales Agent
items.description: Business Skills are natural language instructions authored and stored in Microsoft Dataverse that teach Sales Agent how work gets done within a specific organization. Business Skills enable organizations to create natural language instructions for Sales Agent to follow, which represent their business processes, policies, and business knowledge. Business skills can represent common sales workflows such as lead qualification, pipeline reviews, account planning, opportunity scoring, account brief creation, or organization-specific sales methodologies. Sales Agent uses the instructions in Business Skills to deliver responses that align with the customer's business processes and guidance. Sellers can interact with Sales agent using natural language and receive responses that are guided by their organization's Business Skills, following admin defined sales processes, applying company specific guidance, and surface insights that reflect how the organization operations. Administrators enable the required Dataverse capabilities, create and manage Business skills within Dataverse, and control Business skill access. Business skills can be authored using natural language instructions and associated with the organization's CRM environment.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Commercial Journeys - AI-powered task completion for Microsoft 365 Copilot users
items.description: Commercial Journeys helps information workers stay on top of their most important work when browsing in Microsoft Edge. Powered by AI, it proactively surfaces unfinished, new, and recurring tasks on the Copilot new tab page- with context-rich cards that explain why each task matters now. One click opens a guided execution flow that delivers ready-to-use outputs (emails, documents, presentations, and more), so users can complete their unfinished work faster with higher quality. This feature will be available to users with a Microsoft 365 Copilot Premium license in Edge.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat can now better match search results from Scanned PDFs
items.description: Copilot Chat can now better match search results from Scanned PDFs on Copilot users' files they are working on — content that was previously difficult to search and find. This feature will work for new/updated user's working files on a go-forward basis.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Calculate withholding tax automatically in expense reports
items.description: Organizations can automatically calculate employee withholding taxes (WHT) as part of the expense report process. When employees submit expenses that are subject to withholding tax requirements, the system applies the appropriate tax calculations directly within the expense report workflow. Key capabilities include: Automatic withholding tax calculation for employee expense transactions that require tax deductions. Calculate single or multiple withholding taxes for each category, based on you setup. Calculations can also be simple or compound. Calculate thresholds based on different periods for records, documents, categories (period accumulation), and total (period accumulation). Base calculations on gross or net amounts.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Calculate and report VAT based on expense reports
items.description: Expense Agent supports automated VAT handling for expense reports, which can help simplify tax management and improve reporting accuracy. Key capabilities include: Automatic VAT Calculation : Expense Agent identifies VAT-relevant expense transactions and calculates applicable VAT amounts based on the information in submitted expense reports. VAT-Aware Expense Processing : VAT values are incorporated into the expense review and processing workflow, reducing the need for manual tax calculations. Enhanced VAT Reporting : VAT amounts captured from employee expenses are aggregated and reported, supporting financial reporting and tax recovery processes. Improved Compliance : Standardized VAT handling helps ensure that expense-related tax calculations apply consistently across the organization. Human in the loop : If the VAT calculation is enabled for expense reports, accountants must review VAT calculation and confirm that everything is correct before posting it.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Use assigned projects only in the web app
items.description: Expense Agent web app now uses dedicated resource assignments for projects to determine which projects are available to each user when they create or manage expense entries. Key capabilities include: You can assign dedicated resources (employees) to the whole project or to the specific task. Display only projects or/and tasks where the user is assigned as a resource. Automatically filter project lists based on project-resource relationships. Reduce the risk of users selecting projects that aren't relevant to their role or assignments.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Improve duplicates prevention
items.description: Expense Agent can identify and handle duplicated expense submissions. Key capabilities include: Enhanced duplicate detection that identifies expenses with matching or highly similar details, such as amount, date, merchant, receipt, or transaction information. Proactive guidance that alerts employees when it detects a potential duplicate expense in the current expense report, or one that is already posted. Reduced manual review effort by helping prevent duplicate claims from entering approval and reimbursement workflows. Improved expense data integrity through more intelligent validation and comparison of submitted expenses.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - AI-Driven Approvals
items.description: Expense Agent can validate submitted expense reports against approval policies written in natural language and provide approvers with guidance during the review process. After an employee submits an expense report, the system evaluates both the overall report and the individual expense lines to detect potential policy violations, suspicious patterns, or situations that might require closer attention. This process supports policies that aren't limited to exact thresholds or fixed numeric conditions, such as when business class travel is allowed, what qualifies as an appropriate business meal, or when exceptions to preferred hotel standards might be acceptable. The result is additional review context that helps approvers make better-informed decisions without replacing the final human approval step. By running policy validation after submission, the feature can apply controls at the level of a single expense line in the first release. The feature complements existing approval workflows by highlighting issues, providing context, and helping organizations enforce policy consistently while keeping approvers in control of the final decision.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Add date ranges and vehicle types in your mileage calculation
items.description: Expense Agent now supports advanced mileage rate configuration based on both effective date ranges and vehicle types, enabling more flexible and accurate mileage reimbursement calculations. This enhancement combines mileage rate scheduling with support for differentiated vehicle categories. Key capabilities include additions on the Mileage Rate Setup page: Define mileage rates that are valid only within specific date ranges, allowing organizations to accommodate rate changes over time. Configure separate mileage reimbursement rates for different vehicle types, such as cars, motorcycles, electric vehicles, or other organization-defined vehicle categories. Automatically apply the correct reimbursement rate based on the travel date and selected vehicle type during mileage expense calculation. Support evolving regulatory requirements, company policies, and regional reimbursement standards without requiring manual recalculation of submitted mileage claims. Administrators can maintain a set of mileage rate records that include both an effective date range and an associated vehicle type. When someone creates a mileage expense, Expense Agent evaluates the trip date and the type of vehicle, and then applies the matching reimbursement rate automatically. This evaluation ensures that mileage claims are calculated using the appropriate rate in effect for the specific travel period and mode of transportation.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - More countries and languages
items.description: Expense Agent supports more languages and regions, enabling an experience for users in all countries/regions where Business Central is available, and adding the following languages: Czech, Dutch, Finnish, Icelandic, Italian, Norwegian, and Swedish.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Service tools, skills and plugins are now available for Cowork, Code and Scout
items.description: The updated Service application brings Dynamics 365 Customer Service context, actions, and guided workflows into supported Copilot experiences, including Chat, Cowork, Code, and Scout. Customer service teams can work with service information and take supported actions in the flow of work, reducing the need to switch to Dynamics 365. First-party tools delivered through the Service package on Dynamics 365 MCP respect Dynamics 365 business logic and the user's existing permissions on each call. The package provides a governed foundation for the supported tools and skills. Availability is tracked separately for each experience.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations cross-app: Role-based access controls for ERP agents
items.description: Dynamics 365 ERP security administrators can apply additional, agent-specific security restrictions that take effect when a user accesses the ERP through an agent. Administrators define these restrictions using the existing security model — assigning roles, duties, and privileges that apply only to agent-initiated requests, scoped by legal entity — so that a user's agent session can operate with narrower permissions than the same user holds when working directly in the ERP.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Self-learning for Copilot Studio Agents
items.description: Soon agents can help makers improve agents using lessons from completed runs. It will identify repeated tool sequences that can be handled by workflows to standardize agent behavior, minimize errors, and most importantly control costs. Makers will be presented with recommendations and supporting evidence, expected impact, and the related instruction and tool changes. Makers accept recommendations, configure, test, and publish a refined copy of the agent. This helps improve agent output quality and controls costs while preserving work that requires model judgment and keeping makers in control.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Persistent identity for Copilot Studio Agents
items.description: Makers can now give their Copilot Studio agents their own accounts, making it a governed Microsoft 365 identity for shared, collaborative business processes that spans across teams. With its own mailbox, Teams presence & Office access, the agent can collaborate where work happens while admins can control and govern its access, policies and use as its own first-class entity.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Deep citations in Copilot
items.description: Deep citations let users quickly verify Copilot's results by linking directly to the relevant part of the reference, boosting trust. We're starting with Word and PPT files, then adding Meetings, Web, and PDF references.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Discover & Add Skills from the skill catalog
items.description: With the Skills catalog in Copilot Studio, makers can discover, reuse and selectively share approved organizational skills instead of recreating the same instructions and workflows for every agent. The shared catalog powered by Microsoft 365 App Store enables shared skills to extend across experiences such as Copilot Studio M365 copilot, and Cowork, helping organizations standardize proven ways of working while maintaining centralized governance.

items.title: Work IQ: ExpandedContextIQ
items.description: Expand Context IQ so users can discover and select additional agents, skills, and content sources while composing prompts.

items.title: Work IQ: Custom agents + 3P calls
items.description: Enable Work IQ to invoke custom agents and agents that call supported third-party tools.

items.title: Microsoft Clipchamp: Copilot video creation updates
items.description: Copilot brings agentic video creation to Clipchamp Video Hub. Users can generate, edit, and refine videos from prompts—grounded in explicit documents or implicit WorkIQ knowledge. Preview and playback video directly in chat, then continue iterating towards a finished video.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Enable agents for existing applications in your organization
items.description: For third-party applications already being used in your organization, admins can now discover and enable the corresponding Teams agents from within the Teams Admin Center. Admins receive recommendations for high-value agents and gain visibility into any required configuration changes during the enablement workflow. These agents increase employee productivity by bringing their everyday applications into the flow of work in Teams. This helps organizations get more value from their existing software investments and unlocks more surfaces for the tools their users already rely on.
